patch_description: This candidate reduces trainable parameters back to the proven-efficient regime (3 parameters per block × 6 repeats = 18 circuit params + 2 readout = 20 total), matching the best-observed configuration in prior experiments. It uses a single shared RY rotation layer, a shared parametrized ZZ entangling chain (replacing fixed CZ gates with a trainable Ising ZZ interaction, allowing the entangling strength to be learned rather than fixed), and a single shared RZ rotation layer. This design maximizes parameter sharing (only 3 unique parameter names per block) while retaining full connectivity across the qubit chain, aiming to reproduce the perfect train/val/test accuracy and low loss seen in the best prior run, with maximal parameter economy and fast convergence.
